text:
Protection | Technical 
 Procedure
Introduction
The type SFF relays are digital frequency relays that measure the system 
 frequency The under frequency trip features of the SFF relays used in load 
 conservation schemes.
The first draft is initiated 
 and tested by Eng. Saber Mohamed and eng. Ragab Abd Elgwad, revised by eng. 
 Abd Elazez Shalaby accepted by eng. Mahmoud Badawy, Electrical Maintenance and 
 Protection Manager, and approved by eng. Ahmed Moussa Executive Operation and 
 Maintenance Manager, revised by quality control head sector eng. Gamal Abdel 
 Wahab
Safety Precautions
A work order must be issued.
The maintenance staff should be qualified and carry the 
 suitable safety ID category.
Wear safety and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety 
 shoes, anti static hand probe to avoid electrical shock etc
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is 
 required
The generator must be isolated and work permit required.
Switch off DC power supply before inserting or withdrawing any card from the 
 relay module.
Tools and Equipment
Test set 
 MANTA
Clip on 
 ammeter
Voltmeter
Test 
 leads
Work to be Carried 
Out
Pick up frequency
Time test
Cut off voltage
Function test
To Get Time
Use the same connection
Adjust the frequency at 45 HZ and voltage to 100V
Start inject the time
To Get Cut Off Voltage
Set voltage under cut off voltage nearly 20 volt for example
Set F under pick up frequency then increase V until trip occurs then record V
